segments.oily: One reviewer with oily, acne-prone skin reports her skin felt less oily after using the mist.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin describe it as an easy way to add moisture and soften their face, especially when paired with a moisturizer afterward.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including several with rosacea or a compromised barrier from other treatments, consistently report the mist calms redness and irritation without stinging or triggering flare-ups.

concerns.dehydration: The overwhelming majority of reviewers describe the mist as instantly hydrating and refreshing, often using it to prep skin before serum or moisturizer or to cool down in heat; several note it isn't a standalone miracle and should be sealed in with a moisturizer or hyaluronic acid rather than left to evaporate, which one reviewer says can otherwise cause dryness.
concerns.redness: Many reviewers, including several with rosacea or general redness, report the mist calms and cools irritated, flushed skin almost instantly, with no reviewer describing increased redness from using it.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer with extremely sensitive, dry skin credits regular use with keeping her skin clear of bumps, acne, and rashes.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with oily, acne-prone skin reports her skin felt less oily after spraying, and another noted it visibly tightens the look of her pores.

extraits.titre: My Skin is So Happy and Refreshed
extraits.texte: I have extremely sensitive dry skin. Since it's summer, even though my natural skin tone is tan, am prone to sunburns, and when that happens, it flares my other skin issues. I was so nervous to try another new product, but this face mist is so refreshing and now my favorite go-to when I need a boost of hydration. I find no irritation and it helps a lot with keeping my skin clear of bumps, acne, redness, rashes, and peeling. FYI the details and instructions on the bottle are in French, but I generally just spray all over my face and neck when I need hydration or feeling like I have tired skin. I find that after I let it dry on my face I do need to follow up with a little face lotion because it makes my pores small and skin feeling kind of tight. Overall, a treat for my skin, get this if you're a lazy girl like me and want a quick 1-step hydrating routine.

extraits.titre: I'm in love with this product !
extraits.texte: I just turned 38, and after not taking proper care of my skin for years, I decided to start once I noticed my skin was aging horribly. I used really expensive skincare products at the time and they really didn't make a big difference. I have melasma and started to see some dimpling plus of course, wrinkles. I got a chemical peel which was good, but left me with an over sensitive skin and compromised natural barrier. I stopped using lancôme products because they are way too irritating for my skin. I started using CeraVe and LaRoche Possay moisturizers for sensitive skin which are also so soft and kind to my skin, I also love they are very budget friendly. But I didn't really like the feeling on my skin, it felt too thick and bulky so I thought I would try a lightweight spray or something, good thing I checked on Amazon, because I haven't seen this at the drugstore. In case anyone is experiencing problems with aging, over sensitive skin and you find my skincare routine useful, I now use a lanolin-avocado gel to wash my face, the alcohol free toner from La Roche Possay which is alcohol free, I use a few vitamin C drops in the morning and immediately apply this spray to prevent dryness and flaking... After that I apply a mineral sunscreen, I use skinmedica, but La Roche Possay has some really good ones as well. At night I repeat almost the same steps but use retinol instead of vitamin C. Also some moisturizers for the eye area, so my skin is starting to feel and look so much bett

I have rosacea, therefore I have sensitive skin. This is my 1st time purchasing La Roche-Posay's Thermal Spring Water for Sensitive Skin. When you have rosacea you learn what your triggers are. Heat is one of my triggers. This spray is fabulous! It is a fine mist. A quick couple of spritzes and my skin feels cooler and a lot less irritated. It is now my favorite La Roche-Posay product! I highly recommend anyone with rosacea to give this product a try. Amazon does sell this product at a higher price. It is approximately $2 more on Amazon than it is on the company's website for the same size bottle.

Im on my 2nd bottle of this and I use it to dampen my face before serums and moisturizer and its amazing for that. I dont think spraying this on your face and letting it evaporate makes sense as they suggest because that causes dryness and transepidermal water loss but the way I use it works great.
I have oily acne skin, I feel super easy to use! The skin is less oily after use. After spraying, the face is wet and moisturizing.
